changelog:
Initial release of cashclaw-landing-page skill.

- Generates high-converting, publish-ready landing page copy and responsive HTML using frameworks like AIDA and PAS.
- Structured workflow includes client brief analysis, wireframe approval, copywriting, and custom HTML/CSS generation.
- Three pricing tiers: Basic (copy), Standard (copy + HTML/CSS), and Pro (copy + HTML/CSS + A/B variant + conversion notes).
- Pages are tailored to client product, audience, and goals—no generic templates.
- Follows strict rules for CTA, social proof, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance.
- Pro tier includes A/B test variant with documented hypotheses and success metrics.
